projects.Use Case: Company-wide personal AI agent for cross-application knowledge work
projects.Project Summary: Cisco is rolling out MyAgent across its workforce as a governed personal AI agent that can coordinate supervised autonomous workflows across Outlook, Webex, Jira, SharePoint and other enterprise systems using approved models, agents and company data through the Circuit platform.
projects.Scale: Rolling out to 90,000 employees; cross-application supervised workflows on Cisco's Circuit platform
projects.Economic Mechanism: Reduce manual coordination and repetitive knowledge-work steps by letting employees delegate objectives across enterprise applications under governed human oversight
projects.Notes: Cisco says MyAgent is rolling out to 90,000 employees, but availability is not the same as active usage. The disclosed nearly 350% quarter-over-quarter growth refers to agentic interactions on Circuit broadly, not a MyAgent-specific productivity result.

projects.Use Case: Reserved GPU inference capacity for production AI and agentic workloads
projects.Project Summary: QumulusAI completed deployment of 616 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs for Runpod under one- and two-year reserved-capacity agreements, with all 77 GPU nodes active and served from QumulusAI's existing U.S. data-center footprint.
projects.Scale: 616 GPUs across 77 active nodes; full deployment reached in August 2026 ahead of the Sept. 1 target
projects.Economic Mechanism: Expand contracted inference capacity for Runpod customers using distributed existing data-center infrastructure and workload-matched GPU architecture
projects.Notes: All 77 contracted GPU nodes are active and the deployment finished ahead of schedule. This verifies delivery of reserved compute capacity, not customer utilization, revenue realization, or broader demand saturation.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: Cisco says action-taking enterprise agents need a governed architecture connecting approved models, approved systems and enterprise data pathways with human oversight; those controls directly shape MyAgent's cross-application execution design.
bottlenecks.Notes: Integration is the closest stable taxonomy label for the governed cross-system architecture Cisco describes as necessary to scale the agent. This is not evidence of a disclosed outage or failed rollout.

bottlenecks.Evidence Summary: QumulusAI activated all 616 contracted Blackwell GPUs across 77 nodes ahead of the Sept. 1 delivery target specifically to provide Runpod customers with additional production inference and agentic-workload capacity.
bottlenecks.Notes: Compute is recorded as an easing gate because reserved accelerator capacity was delivered and activated. The disclosure does not establish utilization levels or imply that Runpod's broader compute demand is fully met.
